heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: What is an MVP and why does my startup need one?
items.answer: A Minimum Viable Product is the smallest working version of your idea that lets real users try it. It helps you validate demand, gather feedback and attract investors without spending a full-product budget.

items.question: How long does MVP development take?
items.answer: Most MVPs are ready in 8 to 12 weeks, depending on the number of core features, platforms and integrations. We share a clear timeline after the discovery workshop.

items.question: How much does MVP development cost?
items.answer: Cost depends on scope, platforms and design depth. We offer fixed-scope and monthly engagement models so you can start small and scale as you grow.

items.question: Will I own the source code?
items.answer: Yes. You own all source code, designs and documentation once the project is delivered.

items.question: Do you provide support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We offer post-launch maintenance, bug fixing, hosting support and iterative feature development.
